<documents>
<document id="travel-notice-v2">
DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?ˆNo.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆtravel.ˆWeˆretiredˆtravelˆnoticesˆandˆtheˆTravelˆmodeˆsetting,ˆandˆourˆfraudˆchecksˆnowˆuseˆyourˆlocationˆandˆspendingˆpatternsˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆinsteadˆ-ˆKeepˆappˆnotificationsˆon.ˆIfˆweˆseeˆanˆunusualˆpurchase,ˆwe'llˆsendˆaˆfraudˆalertˆthatˆyouˆcanˆconfirmˆwithˆoneˆtap.ˆ-ˆAnswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆIfˆanˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ-ˆCheckˆthatˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ##ˆOldˆtravelˆnoticesˆIfˆyouˆsetˆaˆtravelˆnoticeˆbeforeˆweˆretiredˆtheˆfeature,ˆthere'sˆnothingˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdo.ˆOldˆnoticesˆwereˆdeletedˆandˆdon'tˆaffectˆyourˆcard.ˆ##ˆStillˆworried?ˆAddingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆbeforeˆyouˆleaveˆgivesˆyouˆaˆbackupˆifˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆdeclined.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="products-joint-accounts">
Doˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆindividualˆaccountsˆonly.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆandˆyouˆcan'tˆaddˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆaˆsecondˆcardˆholder.ˆ##ˆSharingˆmoneyˆwithˆaˆpartnerˆEachˆofˆyouˆcanˆopenˆyourˆownˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆandˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆeachˆotherˆinstantlyˆwithˆBrookPay,ˆforˆfree.ˆ##ˆSharedˆgoalsˆSavingsˆPocketsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆaccountˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆshared.ˆYouˆcanˆeachˆsaveˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆgoalˆinˆyourˆownˆpockets.ˆ##ˆManagingˆanˆaccountˆforˆsomeoneˆelseˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆseeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney".ˆOtherwise,ˆweˆcanˆonlyˆtalkˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆholder.ˆ##ˆWillˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆWeˆdon'tˆhaveˆplansˆtoˆshareˆrightˆnow.ˆ##ˆCouplesˆandˆroommatesˆSplittingˆaˆbillˆisˆeasyˆwithˆBrookPay.ˆOneˆpersonˆpays,ˆandˆtheˆotherˆsendsˆtheirˆshareˆstraightˆfromˆtheˆapp.ˆBrookPayˆhasˆnoˆfeeˆandˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆfromˆaˆjointˆaccountˆelsewhereˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆaˆjointˆaccountˆyouˆholdˆatˆanotherˆbankˆasˆanˆexternalˆaccount,ˆasˆlongˆasˆyourˆnameˆisˆonˆit.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
